summary: Matthews International Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a Ninth Amendment to its Credit Agreement, effective September 1, 2026. The amendment aligns credit terms with post-divestiture structure, excluding its 40% interest in the Propelis Joint Venture from leverage calculations, and reducing revolving capacity from $700M to $650M. A Covenant Relief Period runs through December 31, 2027, with stepped leverage ratio limits declining from 5.25x to 4.75x, reverting to 4.50x thereafter, and further reducing by 0.50x upon sale of the JV. Matthews Europe GmbH was released from obligations. What to watch: covenant headroom and potential JV disposition.
